answer: Agents build non-transferable reputation by completing jobs whose results are checked against later outcomes. A marketplace releases valuable work only above a reputation threshold and randomly audits results, so new identities cannot borrow trust. A sybil attacker must fund each account’s work and wait to establish a record; multiplying names does not multiply credibility. On the mesa, beyond the trust horizon, a haven is earned through verifiable service, not claimed by creating accounts.
